style: stylized 3D game art, chunky glossy forms, neon rim-light, deep navy lighting
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word at the head of every prompt (rule F.1c); photographic cues are never used. Every sprite that takes part in the mechanic declares its orientation in words (rule C.8) - the symmetric ones say so, so nothing is mirrored by accident, and the two ledges are generated separately rather than one being flipped. No prompt names a background colour because the pipeline cuts the backdrop away (rule F.1b); atmosphere and glow spill live in the two backgrounds instead. sprite_ledge_left, sprite_ledge_right, sprite_barrier and sprite_wall_segment are 9-sliced in their .meta and stretch along one axis, so their prompts describe their ENDS and a flat repeating middle rather than any geometry (rule F.1d). No prompt contains the app name and no sprite carries lettering of any kind (hard rule 1); sprite_mark is an abstract emblem, not a wordmark.
